Prompt caching is the mechanism that lets Anthropic reuse a prefix between calls. These files implement it:

`src/format/cache-layout.js`
`src/format/cache.js`
`src/config/defaults.js`
`gen-context.js`
`src/session/claude-transcript.js`

`cache-layout.js` splits the output at a volatile marker, so the stable prefix carries `cache_control` (with TTL handling) and the volatile tail does not. `cache.js` turns that into the two-block Anthropic `system` array and payload. `defaults.js` sets the default `cacheLayout` and TTL, and `gen-context.js` emits the stable-prefix ordering. `claude-transcript.js` is the only other source file that handles `cache_control`, so it is listed last.
